newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up, seen range-bounded.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up, seen range-bounded.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished up on Thursday amid selective trade and dealers said the index could remain range-bounded when the market reopens on Sunday after the Friday-Saturday weekend.
"The market has a limited downside but lack of any major positive news is keeping players cautious," dealer Salman Ahmad at Finex Securities said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 2.66 points, or 0.18 percent, to end at 1,478.64. Gainers led losers 153 to 114. Turnover rose to 48.02 million shares from 41.11 million on Wednesday.
Faysal Bank fell 0.60 to 23.75 rupees and Hub Power Co 0.15 to 35.05. Dewan Salman Fibre rose 1.60 to 32.60. PTCL fell 0.70 to 30. ICI Pakistan rose 0.30 to 17.80.
FFC Jordan rose 0.30 to 14.80 and Fauji Fertilizer 1.10 to 77.25. Searle Pakistan rose 3.0 to 41.
Trading value in bln rupees 1.41 MRG
